changes.before:
Matching sets take the guesswork out of getting dressed, and the men's co-ords top is the upper half of a combination that just works every single time. Worn with its matching bottom, it creates a complete and intentionally styled look that appears put together and genuinely modern without requiring any deliberation at all in the morning.
The fabric is soft, comfortable, and breathable with a relaxed contemporary cut that sits well on the body and moves freely throughout the day. Whether at home, heading out casually, or meeting friends, this top brings a cohesive and stylish energy to the outfit that plain separates simply cannot replicate.
Stitched with clean finishing on the neckline, sleeves, and hem so the top holds its shape and overall coordinated character through consistent wear and regular washing cycles. A sharp, practical, and stylish everyday co-ords essential for men who appreciate a thoughtful and well matched everyday look.

Key Features:

  • Designed specifically to pair with matching co-ord bottoms for a complete look
  • Soft and breathable fabric with a relaxed contemporary everyday cut
  • Creates a cohesive and intentionally styled appearance without any effort
  • Clean finishing throughout for lasting shape and coordinated character

Sku: A236622
changes.after:
Upgrade your everyday style with this Men's Oversized Drop Shoulder T-Shirt in a rich coffee brown shade. Designed for the modern Pakistani man, it combines street-style looks with all-day comfort, perfect for Karachi's heat and for casual outings, university, or hanging out with friends.

Key Features:

  • Oversized, boxy fit with drop shoulders for a relaxed, trendy look
  • Premium heavyweight cotton fabric: soft, breathable, and durable
  • Ribbed round neck that holds its shape after repeated washes
  • Plain, minimal design that matches jeans, cargo pants, trousers, or shorts
  • Half sleeves with a clean, stitched finish
  • Easy to style for casual, streetwear, and everyday wear

Why You'll Love It:

  • This plain brown tee is a wardrobe essential. Its earthy tone pairs well with blue denim, black, beige, and olive bottoms. The thick fabric drapes well and doesn't cling, so you stay comfortable in warm weather.

Care Instructions:

  • Machine wash cold with similar colors
  • Do not bleach
  • Iron on low heat
  • Wash inside out to preserve color
